create_VideoInfo: create a VideoInfo object from a video file path to get width, height, fps and total frame count
create_VideoSink: create a VideoSink context manager to write video frames to an output file using OpenCV
run_process_video: run process_video to asynchronously process video frames with a callback function using a threaded pipeline
run_get_video_frames_generator: run get_video_frames_generator to yield video frames with optional stride, start, end and iterative seek options
create_FPSMonitor: create an FPSMonitor to benchmark latency by tracking timestamps and computing average frames per second
